context: Channel for Leg (left, hip to foot).
Ongoing: Six-axis sensor drifts with temperature and bolt preload. This week: Plate re-made flat and bolts torqued in sequence; drift drops to 3 N.
Ongoing: What to show investors when no full humanoid exists
Ongoing: Drop from 30 cm cracks the shank link at the knee clevis
Ongoing: Replace foot switches with a learned contact estimate from joint currents. This week: Kept as a backup to the foot switches; no hardware change.
Ongoing: Whether to machine pelvis plates from 7075 or wait for a casting. This week: Nora: casting tooling quote is $38k and 9 weeks; Lukas wants machined plates for DVT.
